title: Recover Arcadia host services and protected transport
problem: The managed worker may be stopped, the Go-broker profile may be stale, or preservation and Go routing may lack a fresh heartbeat. That prevents safe session-to-session continuation. The restart implementation behind scripts/services.sh defaults to a workspace that does not exist (workspaces/arcadia), so the restart fails unless ARCADIA_WORKSPACE names the martianrover workspace by its absolute path; the managed launch agents behind /runs do not set it.
desired_effect: The managed worker, preservation transport, and Go transport are all freshly verified before Arcadia resumes protected continuation. Run it from a terminal with ARCADIA_WORKSPACE set inline on this one command, never exported in your shell (an exported ARCADIA_WORKSPACE makes the G1, G6, G7 and G8 rehearsal actions refuse, because the workspace then resolves from the environment variable instead of user config): ARCADIA_WORKSPACE=/Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/workspaces/martianrover /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/arcadia/artifacts/generated/operator-scripts/recover-arcadia-host-services.sh run

does: Restart Arcadia's local managed services for the workspace named by an inline ARCADIA_WORKSPACE (exactly /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/workspaces/martianrover)
never_does: Fetch, merge, push, checkout, or otherwise change Git state
Deploy, publish, settle governance, or bypass protected preservation

success.effect: Protected preservation and Go routing are ready for a fresh Arcadia continuation.
success.next: Start a new session and run arcadia advance. Leave ARCADIA_WORKSPACE unexported in your shell.

failure.effect: The script exits non-zero and writes a failure handoff plus its complete run log under runs/<timestamp-pid>/.
failure.next: Give the handoff and run log to Arcadia. If the log says 'Arcadia workspace not found', rerun exactly: ARCADIA_WORKSPACE=/Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/workspaces/martianrover /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/arcadia/artifacts/generated/operator-scripts/recover-arcadia-host-services.sh run (absolute path, inline, never exported). Otherwise a coding agent should diagnose the first failing command and generate a narrower follow-up script only if safe.
